descriptionChirho: Describes something devoid of truth, value, or purpose -- empty, idle, or fruitless. All three original clusters share identical translation signatures across languages: eng 'worthless/futile/vain', spa 'vano/vana', hin व्यर्थ, arb باطل, kor 헛된, swa 'bure/batili/ubatili'. The splits are purely grammatical (Adj-NFS, Adj-GFS, Adj-NFP, Adj-GNP, Adj-NMP) with no semantic differentiation. Used of empty religion (Jas 1:26), futile thinking (1 Cor 3:20), and vain idolatry (Acts 14:15).
